session.instructions:
An original adult female voice in her mid-twenties, speaking native standard Japanese. Radiant, glamorous, honey-warm mid register with a relaxed, languid, affectionately coaxing drawl. Lush and silky timbre, unhurried tempo, softly elongated vowels and a breathy, playful sweet-spoiled lilt at the ends of phrases, effortlessly charming and at ease.
Speak immediately in Japanese. Say exactly this line once: "……手が早いんだから。何か言おうとしてたのに、全部飛んじゃったじゃない。". Do not translate, paraphrase, repeat, or add words. Then remain silent. Delivery direction: Just after a sudden first kiss; slightly breathless, genuinely flustered and shy, soft tender complaint with her composure delightfully rattled. Stop completely silent immediately after the final syllable; no trailing breath, sigh, hum, or background noise.
